newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 14-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 14-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of 14-day system repurchase agreements on Thursday, the New York Fed said.

The operation, the first in the new maintenance period, was expected by analysts, given the Fed's projected add need of about $13.5 billion in the first week and $14.5 billion a day in the second week.
Fed funds were trading slightly above target at 5-5/16 percent when the Fed entered the open market.
